assumptions_and_limits: Exact hash-bound Miniplanets ROM and reviewed source domain; not a generic arbitrary-ROM decompilation result.
All55 stage loads and first-frame states qualify through assisted procedure dispatch; this is not a natural play-through of all55 levels.
The four3301host-frame no-input benchmarks seed real level state and set Muteki255 to keep the player alive. Clock and rendering then execute through the ordinary loop.
Reported logic Hz is completed game updates per emulated console second; the host can emulate faster than real time. These rates do not meet60Hz and the densest measured stage is9.559628655944238Hz.

The fixed784-host-frame movement schedule remains a valid DNF. A separate read-only feedback controller sends only ordinary buttons, completes key/goal/tally/next-stage, then remains neutral1500hostframes.
Normal comparison covers the34-field published projection; complete79-variable comparisons are controlled component cases.
HV and sound-busy observations are explicit environment inputs; finalr14 records and replays140HV words.

Actual core/ROM/toolchain/runtime-resource hashes, all private traces and historical failures remain separately retained. No whole-game formal proof, physical NES hardware qualification, pixel identity or original FM timbre claim.
